Usage: bb thread <command> [options]

Create, message, wait on and read threads

Commands:
  spawn         Create a thread and send its first prompt
  tell          Send a message; a busy thread queues it
  wait          Block until a thread reaches a status (default idle) or event
  show          Show a thread, its environment and its TODOs
  log           Print the timeline, or raw events as JSON
  output        Print the final assistant message of the last turn
  history       List a thread's prompt history
  list          List threads
  update        Change title, parent, section, model or visibility
  commands      List the agent's own slash commands
  options       Show or change the agent's own options
  stop          Stop work and release the agent runtime
  archive       Archive a thread and its children
  unarchive     Unarchive a thread
  compact       Compact the context of an idle thread
  clear         Clear the model context of an idle thread
  retry         Send the failed turn of a thread again
  pin           Pin a thread
  unpin         Unpin a thread
  read          Mark a thread read
  unread        Mark a thread unread
  delete        Delete a thread permanently
  search        Search thread titles and messages
  open          Open a thread in the app, optionally with a file
  interactions  Approvals, questions and plugin forms of a thread
  queue         Messages waiting to be sent to a thread
  section       Sidebar sections

Run `bb thread <command> --help` for details and `bb guide` for concepts. Enabled plugins add commands such as `bb tasks`; see `bb plugin list`.

With --json a failure prints {"ok": false, "error": {code, message, hint?}} on stdout, the readable message on stderr, and exits non-zero.
